text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, finally found ya.
—Hey, got something I gotta tell ya.
choice_data_list: Something to tell me? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ever heard of a crew called the "Grizzlies"?
Apparently, this area around here is their turf.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Their head honcho's pissed at me for some reason.
...Said I didn't show proper respect or whatever? What a pain in the ass.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Still, we're the ones who walked onto someone else's turf.
It'd be lame as hell not to handle things properly.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So yeah.
I'm gonna go charge right into their face.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: And you're coming with me.

text_block_list.name: Cornrowed Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...Pokke-san. Like I said earlier...
are you sure you don't want us to back you up?

text_block_list.name: Cornrowed Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san's just a civilian, right?
Isn't that dangerous?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Stay out of it. It's my call.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —I can count on you, right, Trainer?

Truth be told, I'm scared... but as the one in charge of training her,
there is no way I can let Jungle Pocket go alone.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Alright. —Then get ready.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —You the bunch calling yourselves the "Grizzlies"?

text_block_list.name: Grizzlies Leader
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. So you really did come here, you Demon of Tokyo!
I've heard all about your legend. Been dyin' to meet ya!

I brace myself to act the second anything goes wrong. At the very least,
I have to make sure Jungle Pocket doesn't get hurt...!

text_block_list.name: Grizzlies Leader
text_block_list.text:
Didn't think you'd actually show your face here... Heheheh!
Alright, guys! Give this outsider our official welcome!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Holy crap, this is DELICIOUS! What the heck is this?!
Is this seriously a carrot?! I've never had anything like this in my life!!

text_block_list.name: Grizzly Head
text_block_list.text:
Damn straight it is! That right there's our local pride—
the Queen Carrot! Got a whole 'nother level of sweetness than regular ones!

text_block_list.name: Grizzly Head
text_block_list.text:
Heh... The Demon of Tokyo came all the way out to our turf, after all!
If we didn't hook you up with something this good, our rep would take a hit!

It seemed the Grizzly gang were just disgruntled about not getting a proper greeting,
and in truth, actually held deep respect and admiration for Jungle Pocket.

text_block_list.name: Grizzly Head
text_block_list.text:
By the way, there's a huge festival going down tonight around here!
All the locals are gonna hype it up, so you better come through!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A festival?! For real?! Hell yeah, I'm down!
—Hey! You're comin' too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! A shooting gallery!! Heheh, man, it's been a while!
Oi, keep your eyes glued on me, got it? I'm shootin' down the biggest prize!
choice_data_list: Shouldn't we eat the food we bought first?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, right you are! First, grub—Whoa! They got goldfish
scooping too?! Hey, let's have a showdown! Loser buys cotton candy!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Oho. Is that a chocolate-covered banana?
When'd you buy that? Gimme a bite too!
choice_data_list: If you want one, the stall's over—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: *Chomp.*

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm!
Whoa, this is insanely good! Hey, hey, one more bite!
choice_data_list: D-Don't just take food out of people's hands...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Aw, c'mon, partner! Don't be so stingy!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, over here, over here!
Someone tipped me off to this secret viewing spot!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Wonder when the fireworks'll start!
How many d'ya think there'll be? Hope the show goes on forever!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oho! Look at you, all hyped up!
That's the spirit. Let's live it up to the max!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Say, thanks for today!
For comin' along with me to the Grizzly gang's turf.
choice_data_list: I'm your Trainer. It's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh! Guess that's true!

Looking at her beaming face, a sudden question crosses my mind—
Why was I the one she chose?
choice_data_list: Didn't you find me a bit unreliable?
Didn't you find me a bit unreliable?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What, you don't get it either?
Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, that Grizzly head was sayin' something pretty similar—

text_block_list.name: Grizzly Head
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, mind if I ask ya one thing?
Why do you drag someone like that around with you?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What do ya mean, 'someone like that'...
You talkin' about my Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Grizzly Head
text_block_list.text:
You're the 'Demon of Tokyo', ain'tcha? If you're rollin' with someone,
shouldn't it be someone who ain't so wishy-washy—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Oi. Stop right there.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You don't wanna regret what you say next, do ya?

text_block_list.name: Grizzly Head
text_block_list.text:
...My bad, alright? I didn't mean nothin' by it.
Just thought it was kinda weird, is all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't go judgin' 'em just 'cause they look soft.
...My Trainer's cool as hell on the inside, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
When push comes to shove, they stand their ground with pure guts.
—I've seen it with my own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Makes me wanna put my whole heart in their hands.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, maybe they could use a little more muscle? But hey...
I ain't talkin' out of my ass here. I mean it. For real.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You get me, partner?

I give a firm nod to her question. ...From the bottom of my heart, I felt truly happy.
I had genuinely earned Jungle Pocket's trust.

It felt as though I was that much closer to becoming the "partner" I had always strived to be.
And that filled me with immense pride.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-ho?! ...Awesome!!
TAMAYA-A-A-A-A!!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Way too quiet, way too quiet! Nobody can hear that, man!
Belt it out louder, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
TA-A-A-MA-A-A-YA-A-A-A-A!!!
C'mon, give it a shot! From the gut!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
AHAHAHA! Yeah!! That's what I'm talkin' about!!
*Inhaaale*... TA-A-A-A-MA-A-A-YA-A-A-A-A-A-A-A!!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: LET'S KEEP KICKIN' BUTT TOGETHER, ALRIGHT?! PARTNER-R-R-R-R-R-R!!! ...Heheh!
